استجلين (form X)
# اِسْتَجْلَيْنَ (istajlayna) /is.tad͡ʒ.laj.na/: third-person feminine plural past active of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# اُسْتُجْلِينَ (ustujlīna) /us.tud͡ʒ.liː.na/: third-person feminine plural past passive of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
# اِسْتَجْلِينَ (istajlīna) /is.tad͡ʒ.liː.na/: second-person feminine plural imperative of اِسْتَجْلَى (istajlā)
